title: Universal Navigation & Breadcrumb Protocol
summary: Consolidated internal dashboard tabs into a persistent BridgeSidebar and integrated a Breadcrumb row for structural pathing.
key_findings: Top-right tab navigation was difficult to identify during high-intensity mission sequences.
Contextual breadcrumbs satisfy Counselor Troi's empathy requirement for user presence.
The 'Integrity' domain is now a first-class navigation node as recommended by Dr. Crusher.
conclusions: Navigation is now nominal. The Sovereign Factory UI provides a unified access point for all system business units (Fleet Command).
recommendations: Link the 'Fleet Command' cards to dynamic subdomain URLs (e.g., civic.pbradygeorgen.com).
Implement real-time health indicator lights in the Sidebar for active domains.
